title: Ensure each pipeline has a single responsibility
description: A pipeline that tests, builds and deploys holds the union of those credentials, and a compromise of any stage reaches all of them. No API can judge what a pipeline is for, so this is a review, not a scan.
remediation: Review what this job does end to end, at Configure -> Pipeline or in its Jenkinsfile. If it carries more than one responsibility — building and deploying, say — split it into separate jobs, each holding only the credentials its own stage needs, chained by triggering the next stage rather than sharing one credential set.
fixSummary: Review the job's Pipeline settings and split multi-purpose stages into separate jobs.
